content.text:
A supported compatibility-event ordering can erase the only available restore capability and reproduce the empty-card failure this patch is intended to fix.

Review comment:

- [P1] Preserve compatibility tokens across metadata-less replays — /Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-v8/packages/owletto/src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx:379-379
  When ChatGPT supplies the restore token through `openai:set_globals` metadata and then emits an empty standard `toolresult` without `_meta`, this assignment replaces the retained token with `null`. An in-flight capability restore is then rejected by the capability check, and without `toolInfo` there is no fallback identity, leaving the card blank. Distinguish omitted metadata from an explicit capability clear for empty replays.
